# Adapted skill references

The original MyAI workspace workflows in this directory were written for this repository. Their topics were informed by the supplied archives:

- `claude-skills-main.zip` (MIT; Alireza Rezvani): engineering and prompt-workflow skill collection.
- `GPT-Image2-Skill-main.zip` (MIT; Wuyoscar): image-generation and image-reference prompt workflows.
- `gpt-image2-ppt-skills-main.zip` (Apache-2.0): presentation and slide-production workflow.

No archive scripts, executables, model assets, or substantial source text were copied into the workspace or executed. The workflows are adapted to MyAI's existing provider, image, and document pipelines.
